comment: Choice Hotels / Alpha Brand Studios — Americas CALA development (same Explorer mapping as Radisson (Choice)).
suggestedTargetGuestSegments: The Inspired Professional: aged 28–55, urban, HHI $100–199k, allergic to boring traditional hotel experiences; balances intense career with exploration—novels, art, underground dining; expects seamless technology and flexible wellness/social/function in-room and public spaces.

fields.Brand Positioning: We exist to redefine the upper-upscale hospitality experience—challenging the norm with a stay that combines style with substance, innovation with comfort, and a sense of belonging in an elevated environment.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: Scandinavian-inspired design throughout offers comfort, distinctiveness, and warmth—dynamic, stimulating spaces that invite guests to spark imagination and transcend the ordinary.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Enticing Moments—subtle innovation that fosters belonging and discovery.

Owners: Iconic upper-upscale brand with Choice upscale platform support in Americas markets; development via choicehotelsdevelopment.com / upscalebychoice.com.

Choice: Distinct upper-upscale brand for top urban and resort destinations under the Choice-affiliated portfolio.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Enticing Moments (Experience): seamless environment fostering belonging and discovery.

Nordic Nouveau (Design): Scandinavian-inspired comfort, distinctiveness, and warmth.

Curatorial Warmth (Service): professional warmth akin to an art-gallery curator.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Enticing Moments — experience pillar.

Nordic Nouveau — design pillar.

Curatorial Warmth — service pillar.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Inspired Professionals find traditional spaces uninspired—design-forward-but-sterile vs. big-box-but-boring. Travel often; public spaces for work/social; guest rooms for decompression with seamless technology.
fields.Brand History: Heritage from the 1960 Arne Jacobsen design-hotel vision; Americas upper-upscale positioning under Choice affiliation. Confirm historical claims in brand materials provided with your agreement.
